trials.claim: Lifetime access to BackgroundCut Plan on 1 Code tier
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to BackgroundCut Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let the operator restrict or block users without reasons and limit use to non-commercial purposes, materially limiting the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: The Operator has the right to restrict the use of the Platform without giving reasons or to block Users.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be restricted or blocked at any time without reasons, so it is not unconditional.

exhibits.quote: The User may use the platform which is accessible under backgroundcut.co exclusively for non-commercial purposes.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is limited to non-commercial private use only, undermining broad lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I was able to drastically reduce my editing time for a one-time price with monthly credits.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the deal is a one-time price with recurring monthly credits, supporting lifetime access.

exhibits.argument: Monthly credits expire after 90 days, so they are not kept forever.

exhibits.quote: Processing stops immediately. To continue, top up from the pricing page.
